verses.pali: Tena kho pana samayena bhagavā bhikkhūnaṁ nibbānapaṭisaṁyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṁseti.
verses.english: Now at that time the Buddha was educating, encouraging, firing up, and inspiring the mendicants with a Dhamma talk about extinguishment.

verses.pali: Te ca bhikkhū aṭṭhiṁ katvā manasi katvā sabbacetasā samannāharitvā ohitasotā dhammaṁ suṇanti.
verses.english: And those mendicants were paying attention, applying the mind, concentrating wholeheartedly, and actively listening.

verses.pali: “ayaṁ kho samaṇo gotamo bhikkhūnaṁ nibbānapaṭisaṁyuttāya dhammiyā kathāya …pe…
verses.english: “The ascetic Gotama is giving a Dhamma talk about extinguishment … and the mendicants are listening well.

verses.pali: yannūnāhaṁ yena samaṇo gotamo tenupasaṅkameyyaṁ vicakkhukammāyā”ti.
verses.english: Why don’t I go and pull the wool over their eyes?”

verses.pali: Atha kho māro pāpimā kassakavaṇṇaṁ abhinimminitvā mahantaṁ naṅgalaṁ khandhe karitvā dīghapācanayaṭṭhiṁ gahetvā haṭahaṭakeso sāṇasāṭinivattho kaddamamakkhitehi pādehi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Māra the Wicked manifested in the form of a farmer carrying a large plough on his shoulder. He held a long goad, his hair was messy, he was clad in sunn hemp, and his feet were muddy. He went up to the Buddha and said to him,
“So, ascetic, did you happen to see any oxen?”
“But what have you to do with oxen, Wicked One?”

verses.pali: “Mameva, samaṇa, cakkhu, mama rūpā, mama cakkhusamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ.
verses.english: “Mine alone, ascetic, is the eye, mine are sights, mine is the field of eye contact consciousness.
Where can you escape me, ascetic?

verses.pali: mameva, samaṇa, mano, mama dhammā, mama manosamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ.
verses.english: mind, mine are ideas, mine is the field of mind contact consciousness.
Where can you escape me, ascetic?”

verses.pali: “Taveva, pāpima, cakkhu, tava rūpā, tava cakkhusamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ.
verses.english: “Yours alone, Wicked One, is the eye, yours are sights, yours is the field of eye contact consciousness.

verses.pali: Yattha ca kho, pāpima, natthi cakkhu, natthi rūpā, natthi cakkhusamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ, agati tava tattha, pāpima.
verses.english: Where there is no eye, no sights, no eye contact consciousness—you have no place there, Wicked One!

verses.pali: Taveva, pāpima, sotaṁ, tava saddā, tava sotasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ.
Yattha ca kho, pāpima, natthi sotaṁ, natthi saddā, natthi sotasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ, agati tava tattha, pāpima.
Taveva, pāpima, ghānaṁ, tava gandhā, tava ghānasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ.
Yattha ca kho, pāpima, natthi ghānaṁ, natthi gandhā, natthi ghānasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ, agati tava tattha, pāpima.
Taveva, pāpima, jivhā, tava rasā, tava jivhāsamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ …pe…
taveva, pāpima, kāyo, tava phoṭṭhabbā, tava kāyasamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ …pe…
taveva, pāpima, mano, tava dhammā, tava manosamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ.
verses.english: mind, yours are ideas, yours is the field of mind contact consciousness.

verses.pali: Yattha ca kho, pāpima, natthi mano, natthi dhammā, natthi manosamphassaviññāṇāyatanaṁ, agati tava tattha, pāpimā”ti.
verses.english: Where there is no mind, no ideas, no mind contact consciousness—you have no place there, Wicked One!”
“The things they speak of aren’t mine;
I’m not someone who speaks like that.
you won’t even see the path I take.”
